title: SuspiciousLogin Dataset: An Anonymized Benchmark of Suspicious Successful Login Events from Google Workspace
description: An anonymized benchmark of successful Google Workspace login events, labeled as suspicious or not by Google's own operational signal (is_suspicious), combining data from two higher-education institutions. 73,528 events, 36,691 pseudonymized users, spanning December 2025 to August 2026. Includes 38 engineered behavioral, temporal, and geographic features, an empirically-validated risk score (logistic-regression-derived, chronologically validated), and reference machine-learning benchmark results (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, Isolation Forest). The is_suspicious label is an operational signal supplied by Google Workspace, not a forensic confirmation of phishing, credential stuffing, brute force, or actual account compromise. Full methodology, data dictionary, schema, and privacy/anonymization report included, in Portuguese and English.

notes: The restricted schema (with precise timestamps, city, coordinates, and network identifiers) is never published and is not part of this record -- only the public schema, safe demo sample, code, and documentation are included. See PRIVACY_ANONYMIZATION_REPORT.md for the full data governance methodology.
